column3: Close to the Greek; “went after” is rendered “searched for.”
Close to the Greek; “village-towns” is rendered “next towns.”
NKJV has “He was preaching in their synagogues,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “He went preaching into their synagogues.”
NKJV includes “As soon as He had spoken,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text begins “And immediately.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV supplies “Jesus” as the subject of “could no longer.”
